packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI (detekt/lint/test/kover/build) is green. Renovate merges them itself (platformAutomerge off): main has no branch protection, so GitHub's auto-merge would not wait for CI.
Major versions never auto-merge: they are held, labelled needs-review, and looked at at the start of each batch (ADR 41).
One grouped PR for routine Gradle library bumps (versions live in the catalog).
Media3 is the playback engine, and a playback change ships only after a soak against the build before it (CLAUDE.md) - so it gets its own PR and never auto-merges.
Group and auto-merge GitHub Actions bumps (also clears the Node 20 deprecation warnings).
Kotlin and KSP must move in lockstep and can break builds — review manually.
AGP updates gate on compileSdk compatibility — review manually.
Chaquopy is pinned to the build-host Python minor (3.12) — review manually.
Bumping a bundled binary means re-running its build script by hand and committing new .so files, which no CI job does — so these must never auto-merge.

customManagers.description: QuickJS, cross-compiled by tools/quickjs. Its version is a shell variable that no built-in manager reads — which is how it sat on 0.10.1, a release yt-dlp warns is far too slow to solve its JS challenges (500s vs 8s).
FFmpeg, cross-compiled by tools/ffmpeg. Same reason; tags are prefixed 'n'.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix does not wait for the weekend or the 3-day age: it is raised at once and merged on green CI (ADR 41, 2026-10-28).
